title: TaladHub: Market research field work and MVP testing to create solutions for real users
image1Description: Field Research and talking with stakeholders in the real market

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: Under the 'Talad Hub' project, which focuses on improving market management with technology, I believe the heart of product development is understanding real problems from the actual location. I intended to go to the field to collect data and test MVP (Minimum Viable Product) assumptions. The goal was to find the connection between technology and the traditional lifestyle of the market to create a solution that solves problems correctly and creates sustainable real-world use.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: I served as a Field Researcher collecting deep data (Qualitative Research) through interviews and surveys with all related parties, from vendors and buyers to the market management team. I observed real usage behavior and gathered hidden Pain Points, including talking with market executives to understand management dimensions. I used this data to analyze and adjust TaladHub features to best match the real usage context.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The major challenge was changing the 'worry' of local people into 'cooperation.' I had to explain complex technology in an easy way and show that we were there to help solve problems, not to create more burden. Also, filtering the highly diverse data to find the most important Core Needs amidst a high-pressure environment required constant negotiation skills.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: From the real field work, we were able to improve the TaladHub solution to have higher business possibility and meet user needs much more clearly. This experience taught me that 'data from the field is the best teacher.' I developed User Empathy skills and systematic Market Validation, which are important foundations that make our product strong and ready for the next level of competition with confidence based on reality.
